messages:
incident-bot: automated page fired — latency_p99 us-west > 2.8s for 5m, severity: high. PD: https://pd.example/INC-9042

pagerduty-bot: routed to rotation -> @sara-oncall, escalation in 3m if unacked

sara-oncall: acked. I'm on it, grabbing dashboards + flamegraphs now :coffee: 

tom-sre: joining. seeing a p99 jump to ~3.2s at 15:12 UTC. any recent deploys?

sara-oncall: no deploys in last 30m. grafana panel: /d/redwood/serving-latency?panel=7 — p99 for embeddings spiked, p50/p95 fine

riley-runtime: logs show a burst of cache evictions from emb-encoder nodes; batcher queue grew, backpressure kicked in. likely hot-key churn.

tom-sre: infra: kv-sidecar CPU 93%, eviction-rate 780/s, pod restarts zero. ephemeral thrash.

sara-oncall: can we do a short canary traffic split to a smaller, quantized model pool? route 15% and see.

riley-runtime: yes. applying diversion now. command used:
```
redwood route split --service embeddings --split 85:15 --to default:light-quantized-pool
```

maya-support: support metrics: marginal increase in transient 502s from real-time widgets, but no major customer alerts. I'll keep watch.

sara-oncall: also bumping batcher concurrency for encoder workers to clear backlog (temporary):
```
kubectl patch deploy emb-batcher -n serving -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"batcher","env":[{"name":"BATCHER_CONCURRENCY","value":"8"}]}]}}}}'
```


tom-sre: scaling kv-sidecar replica set +3 to absorb thrash, should spin up in ~40s.

riley-runtime: observing telemetry: emb-encoder queue length falling, p99 down to 1.2s within 70s of split. interestingly, hot-key frequency concentrated on 3 keys.

sara-oncall: enabling short-lived suppression in alerting for pattern "cache_eviction_burst" so PD doesn't re-fire while mitigation in progress. will log in alert rules.

maya-support: no new customer tickets; support will prep a brief note if this extends past 30m.

incident-bot: escalation timer: 02:10 remaining

riley-runtime: enabling prefix caching for top hot-keys (tiered cache) via feature flag rollout (no restart). patch: feature/ops/prefix-cache-hotkeys.

sara-oncall: p99 now ~770ms and trending down. keeping 15% canary for 10m to ensure stability.

tom-sre: kv eviction rate down 85%, new sidecars healthy. good signal.

sara-oncall: marking PD incident as acknowledged + mitigation active; will resolve if stable for 10m. filing follow-up items: add automatic suppression for cache-thrash, tune alert threshold, add hot-key detector metric.

pagerduty-bot: reminder: incident will escalate in 2m if not resolved

sara-oncall: resolving PD (mitigation success) — diversion + scale + prefix-cache reduced p99 under alert threshold. will write concise postmortem in #postmortems and open runbook PR.

incident-bot: incident INC-9042 closed by sara-oncall. duration ~14m.

maya-support: noted. adding customer comms draft to the postmortem.

riley-runtime: opened PR: https://git.example/r/redwood/ops/PR-2048 for alert suppression + hotkey detector.

sara-oncall: thanks everyone. follow-up: 1) add automated canary split playbook 2) instrument hot-key heatmap 3) evaluate lowering p99 alert sensitivity or add cache-thrash filter.
